from sympy.combinatorics import Permutation
from sympy.combinatorics.permutations import Perm

class MyPerm(Permutation):
    pass

# 1. direct construction
p = MyPerm([1, 0, 2])
assert type(p) is MyPerm, type(p)

# 2. all __new__ branches
assert type(MyPerm()) is MyPerm
assert type(MyPerm(1, 2)) is MyPerm
assert type(MyPerm([[1, 2]])) is MyPerm
assert type(MyPerm(3)) is MyPerm
assert type(MyPerm(Permutation([0, 2, 1]))) is MyPerm
assert type(MyPerm(Permutation([0, 2, 1]), size=4)) is MyPerm

# 3. internal _af_new paths return the subclass
assert type(~p) is MyPerm                      # __invert__
assert type(p*Permutation([2, 1, 0])) is MyPerm  # __mul__
assert type(p**2) is MyPerm                    # __pow__
assert type(p.next_lex()) is MyPerm
assert type(Permutation.rmul_with_af(p, p)) is MyPerm
assert type(p + 1) is MyPerm                   # __add__ -> unrank_lex
assert type(p.unrank_trotterjohnson(3, 1)) is MyPerm
assert type(Permutation.josephus(2, 5)) is MyPerm
assert type(Permutation.from_inversion_vector([0, 0, 0])) is MyPerm
assert type(Permutation.random(4)) is MyPerm
assert type(Permutation.unrank_lex(4, 3)) is MyPerm
assert type(p ^ p) is MyPerm                   # __xor__ conjugate
assert type(p.commutator(p)) is MyPerm
assert type(-p) is MyPerm                      # __neg__ -> next_nonlex path? check
# 4. base class still works
assert type(Permutation([1, 0])) is Permutation
# 5. equality/hash across classes
assert p == Permutation([1, 0, 2])
assert hash(p) == hash(Permutation([1, 0, 2]))
print('SUBCLASS TESTS: ALL PASS')
